title: Require Service Contract Authority
forbids: a module contract directory whose index lacks one generic exported contract anchor or at least one filename-mapped direct leaf import; contract source acquiring module implementation, router, or middleware faces; a contract leaf cycling through its own index; a direct contract leaf without exactly one filename-mapped public operation or group export; export-list aliasing except for an ECMAScript-reserved public operation name; native input, output, or error construction outside a module-scope const initializer; a contract operation or group without Standard Schema adaptation at every input, output, or public error-data position; a contract, reusable DTO, error-data, or entity schema using executable, unsafe, native-only, or pre-2020-12 TypeBox capabilities; imported, computed, spread, or exported error-map authority; and an imported or non-top-level shorthand error item
why: A module contract directory exposes one generic native oRPC contract authority through index.ts while direct semantic leaves own one filename-mapped public operation or deliberate group. Private spelling is not public contract authority, including when an ECMAScript-reserved public key requires an export-list alias. Public input, output, error-data, DTO, and entity schemas use TypeBox's native JSON Schema builders and one Standard Schema adapter without silently projecting away runtime semantics.
remediate: Export the generic contract only from contract/index.ts and prove at least one filename-mapped direct leaf import. Compose that acquired leaf anywhere in the plain or native nested contract tree; TypeScript owns completeness, Knip owns import reachability, and generated client/API behavior proof owns the complete public operation set. Keep native input, output, and error construction in module-scope const initializers, keep contract source independent of module implementation, router, and middleware faces, and keep leaves independent of their own index. Give each kebab-case leaf exactly one lower-camel public runtime export mapped from its filename. For an ECMAScript-reserved public operation, export any private local binding under that filename-mapped name and import the public name under any valid private binding. Keep each canonical entity TypeBox schema and its Static-derived type together. Remove executable, unsafe, native-only, and tuple capabilities from public schemas, and apply standard(TypeBoxSchema) at every input, output, and public error-data position. Declare public errors with an inline map or a direct top-level private const map, admit oRPC's native optional message and data fields in either order, keep shorthand error items as direct top-level private const bindings, and use the handler-supplied errors constructors in procedures.
message: Service module contracts, DTOs, errors, and entities must preserve declarative TypeBox and native error authority.
